game: Grand Theft Auto VI — PlayStation 5 trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours, so treat this entry as the atlas cover rather than a task. PowerPyx scores the full list at 4/10 difficulty and roughly 200 hours, in a single playthrough, with no online trophies anywhere in the set. Work the six roadmap stages in order and this one closes the book on its own.
steps: Clear the story stages I–II, including every chapter trophy.
Finish the side-strand finals in stage III.
Sweep activities and feats in stages IV–V.
Close the collectible and 100% cleanup in stage VI.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story award you cannot avoid: play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from start to finish and it pops at the mission's end. PSNProfiles lists it as a hidden story trophy, the first marker on the Chapter 1 route. Nothing needs preparing — simply do not skip the mission.
steps: Begin a new game.
Play Gone Fishing through its final objective.
Let the results screen roll; the trophy unlocks there.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 and this chapter marker is yours. PowerPyx puts the whole five-chapter story at roughly 60–80 hours, so Chapter 1 is only the shoreline of the journey. One habit matters here: keep a manual save at the chapter's start, because the game's single missable trophy takes its first step inside this chapter, at Jason's house.
steps: Save manually when Chapter 1 begins.
Meditate at Jason's house before the chapter closes (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Play the chapter's missions to its end card.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion marker, asterisks and all — the name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Exophase's listing agrees with the official list on name, wording and bronze grade. Play Chapter 2 to its final mission and the trophy follows automatically; it cannot be missed on a normal story run.
steps: Keep a fresh manual save at the start of Chapter 2.
Work through the chapter's mission chain.
Finish the last Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's completion marker. By this point the map has opened up, and PowerPyx's roadmap suggests banking easy activity trophies between story beats so the endgame cleanup stays short. The trophy itself is automatic: close out Chapter 3's final mission.
steps: Save manually as Chapter 3 opens.
Follow the chapter missions in order.
Complete the chapter finale.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The penultimate chapter marker: finish Chapter 4 and only the finale remains. PSNProfiles lists it among the hidden story trophies. Because there is no mission replay, keep the chapter-start save habit here too — it is cheap insurance for everything downstream.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Play the chapter through.
Finish its closing mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two golds in the set, paid for finishing the story's final mission. PowerPyx notes free-roam continues after the credits, so nothing in the cleanup stages depends on doing this early — but the 100% gold does need the story done. Play the finale when your route reaches it and the gold is automatic.
steps: Complete Chapters 1–4 and their markers.
Start the final mission from the story marker.
See the credits; the gold unlocks with them.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy inside Chapter 1: finish Breakfast Run and it unlocks at the mission summary. GTABase's mission index places it early in the opening chapter, well before the Chapter 1 marker. Story missions cannot be skipped, so a normal run collects this on the way past.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 1.
Complete every objective.
Finish the mission to bank the trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission on the Chapter 3 route. PowerPyx's roadmap treats all named-mission trophies as unmissable story beats: finish the heist, however loud it gets, and the trophy is yours at the summary screen.
steps: Progress the story until The Cartel Heist opens.
Complete the heist's objectives.
Escape and finish the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It sits on the main path, so the only way to lack this trophy is to not have reached the mission yet. PSNProfiles carries it as a hidden bronze story trophy, matching the official wording exactly.
steps: Advance the story to Child's Play.
Play the mission to completion.
Collect the trophy at the summary.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Exophase lists DWNFALL as a hidden bronze tied to that single mission; like every named-mission trophy in this set it is awarded automatically at the mission's end and cannot be permanently missed on a story playthrough.
steps: Reach Headliners on the story route.
Complete all of its objectives.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, the airport-authority story mission GTABase indexes in the middle chapters. The trophy is a completion award only — no medal, timer or style condition is attached — so play it clean or loud and simply reach the end.
steps: Unlock VCIA Takedown through the story.
Work through the takedown objectives.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Operation Savage Glory, a late mid-story mission. PowerPyx groups it with the other unmissable named-mission bronzes: the route to platinum passes straight through it, and the trophy lands when the mission closes.
steps: Progress to Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the operation's objectives.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the longest road on the atlas: reach 100% on the game's completion counter. PowerPyx notes the in-game 100% is only about 60% of everything the world contains, so follow the game's own checklist — story, strands, activities, collectibles — rather than trying to do literally everything. This trophy is why the roadmap ends with a dedicated cleanup stage.
steps: Finish the full story first.
Clear every strand and activity line on the completion checklist.
Sweep remaining collectibles until the counter reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida. The count is the task: stunt spots are scattered over the whole map, and each clean landing adds one. PowerPyx treats this as a grind best spread across the whole playthrough — grab every ramp you pass instead of farming all 250 at the end. A fast bike or light car makes most ramps forgiving.
steps: Note stunt spots as you explore; land each one cleanly.
Keep a rough tally per region so no cluster is left behind.
Reach 250 completed stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The sampler trophy: attempt every distinct activity type in the game at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone racing and the rest of GTABase's activity index. Winning is not required, only trying. Do this early: it teaches you which activities the other trophies will ask you to master.
steps: Open each activity type on the map as it unlocks.
Play one round or event of each.
Repeat until no untouched activity type remains.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them by the published count. PowerPyx's advice for medal grinds applies: learn each challenge's target pattern with a few practice runs, then chase accuracy before speed, since dropped shots cost more than a slow trigger. Challenges can be retried freely, so nothing here is missable.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range and its challenge list.
Practise each challenge until the pattern is familiar.
Post a gold-medal score on all 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win — not just enter — a Top Fun drone race at each race location. PSNProfiles lists the requirement per location, so tick venues off as you travel: one victory per site, and retries are unlimited. Learn each course with a sighting lap, then race it flat out once the gates feel familiar.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location.
Run a practice lap to learn the gate order.
Win the race at every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty race wins, and they must be twenty different races — repeating one easy circuit does not build the count. Exophase's wording matches the official description exactly. Spread the wins across car, bike and off-road events as they unlock; upgrading your vehicle between events keeps later fields beatable.
steps: Enter races across different categories and venues.
Win one, then move to a new race rather than repeating it.
Reach 20 distinct race victories.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in his fishing challenge. GTABase's activity index files fishing among the repeatable pastimes, and this one is a head-to-head: your catch is weighed against Cal's when the timer ends. Use the best rod and bait you have unlocked, fish the marked water, and play it safe with mid-size catches rather than gambling the round on one trophy fish.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal's challenge marker.
Equip your best rod and bait.
Finish the challenge with a heavier total catch than Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at any arcade cabinet. The bar is completion, not a high score: pick the shortest cabinet game you can find, play it to its end screen, and the trophy pops. PSNProfiles lists it as a plain bronze activity award with no score condition attached.
steps: Enter an arcade and choose a cabinet.
Play the game through to its end.
Exit the cabinet after the completion registers.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Close out Andy's side strand by finishing his final mission. Strands unlock in free roam between story beats; PowerPyx's roadmap places them in their own stage because eight finished strands also feed the Strangers & Freaks silver. Follow Andy's markers to the last one and this bronze lands with the strand.
steps: Start Andy's strand from his map marker.
Complete each of his missions in order.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand at its final mission. GTABase indexes the strand among the side-character arcs that open as the map expands; the missions chain from his marker, so work them in the order they appear and the last one pays this trophy.
steps: Find Kenton's first marker and start the strand.
Complete his missions as they unlock.
Finish the final Kenton mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's strand through to his final mission. PSNProfiles carries it as a hidden bronze, like the other strand finals. Keep the strand moving whenever you pass his territory — strands are short, and clearing them early shortens the stage VI cleanup considerably.
steps: Start Billy's strand from his marker.
Work through his mission chain.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The silver that organises stage III: finish eight complete stranger strands anywhere in Leonida. The named finals in this atlas — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — are strands themselves, so finishing those five leaves only three more to find. PowerPyx counts a strand only when its final mission is done, so half-finished arcs pay nothing here.
steps: Finish the five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone).
Hunt three more stranger markers across the map.
Complete each strand's final mission until eight are done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand at its last mission. Exophase lists Supply & Demand as a hidden bronze strand final; the strand also counts toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it earns its place twice on the route to platinum.
steps: Start Randy's strand from his marker.
Complete his missions in sequence.
Finish the final mission for Randy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Close Tyrone's strand with his final mission. GTABase groups it with the other side-character finals; as with every strand, the trophy is awarded only at the very last mission, so do not leave the arc hanging one step from the end.
steps: Pick up Tyrone's strand marker.
Complete the strand's missions.
Finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: ⚑ THE missable trophy of this list — the red flag on the atlas. Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida, and the trap is the first spot: PowerPyx warns that the spot at Jason's house is only reachable during Chapter 1, before that chapter ends; pass it and no later save can recover it without a new playthrough. Meditate there the moment you can, then sweep the remaining spots in free roam at leisure — those stay available all game.
steps: During Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends — this spot is gone afterwards.
Keep a manual save from before the end of Chapter 1 as insurance.
Visit and meditate at every remaining spot across Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and take down one of the unique animals Bret sends you after. GTABase files hunting among Leonida's repeatable activities, but the unique-animal hunts are one-off contracts: accept Bret's hunt, follow the trail clues in the marked area, and bring the animal down cleanly. Any one unique hunt satisfies the trophy.
steps: Meet Bret and accept a unique-animal hunt.
Follow the trail in the marked hunting ground.
Take the unique animal down and report back.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Assemble three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden singly all over the state, so this silver belongs to the cleanup stage: PowerPyx's collectible route sweeps them region by region once the story is done and the whole map is open. Track sets, not loose cards — a set only counts when its last card is in hand.
steps: Pick up every card you pass while playing the story.
After the finale, sweep region by region for the gaps.
Complete any three full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK interaction at 100 different locations. PSNProfiles lists the count plainly: one hundred distinct spots, so returning to a favourite does not advance it. Treat it like the stunt count — tag locations as you travel each region and the total builds itself long before the cleanup stage.
steps: WAiNK at every new spot you discover.
Move region by region so locations are not repeated.
Reach 100 distinct locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the game's Challenges. Challenges are the short scored tasks sprinkled through activities and free roam; Exophase's listing attaches no category condition, so choose the fifty cheapest — short races, range trials and stunt goals you are already doing for other trophies all feed this counter.
steps: Browse the challenge list and mark the shortest ones.
Complete challenges alongside your other stage IV work.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A partner feat: while travelling with your partner, raise a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely — the stars must drain to zero with your partner still with you. PowerPyx files these partner trophies as free-roam feats best staged deliberately: commit the crime somewhere with a fast escape route, break line of sight, and hide until the heat dies.
steps: Travel with your partner in free roam.
Raise the wanted level to exactly four stars.
Break pursuit and stay hidden until all stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies with your partner while the wanted level never fully drops between them. GTABase's robbery notes suggest picking three shops close together: rob the first, drive straight to the second while still wanted, then the third. Losing the heat mid-chain restarts the count, so speed matters more than the take.
steps: Pick three shops in one neighbourhood and take your partner along.
Rob shop one and keep the wanted level alive.
Rob shops two and three back-to-back without losing the heat.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover — get behind the wheel of — 100 different vehicles. PSNProfiles lists it as a discovery count, and ordinary play covers much of it: steal variety, not duplicates. Rich districts, marinas and the airport are dense with models you will not see in traffic elsewhere; a deliberate sweep of parked vehicles finishes the count quickly in the cleanup stage.
steps: Drive every new model you spot in traffic.
Sweep car parks, marinas and wealthy districts for rare models.
Reach 100 distinct vehicles discovered.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion combat ability. PowerPyx's feat advice applies: stage it where enemies cluster — a gang operation or a robbery gone loud — line up five targets before you trigger the ability, and use a weapon that drops each target in one or two hits so the window is never wasted reloading.
steps: Find a group of at least five enemies standing close.
Aim at the group and activate Combat Focus.
Drop five enemies before the effect ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA — Vice City International Airport — take off in an aircraft you were never cleared to fly: steal a plane on the field and get airborne. Exophase lists the description without further conditions; expect a wanted level, so line up on the longest runway, commit to the takeoff, and the trophy should pop as the wheels leave the ground.
steps: Enter the VCIA airfield and find a usable aircraft.
Reach the runway and begin the takeoff roll.
Get airborne to make the unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is the whole clue: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and it is hot inside one — get into a Rhino tank and make use of it. GTABase's vehicle index confirms the Rhino as the military tank; military hardware appears at restricted installations and in late-game chaos, so steal one when the opportunity presents itself and take it for a working drive.
steps: Locate a Rhino tank at a military site or during heavy escalation.
Enter the tank.
Drive and fire it until the trophy registers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A quiet robbery: empty a jewelry store while nobody raises the alarm — no detection, no wanted level. PowerPyx's stealth advice is patience: case the store, enter when staff sightlines are broken, take the goods and leave the way you came. If a detection meter fills, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and watch its staff pattern.
Enter unseen and take the valuables.
Leave the area with no detection raised.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Crack five bank vaults and escape after each one — a vault emptied but a bust on the doorstep does not count. PowerPyx treats vaults as the heavy end of the robbery line: scout the escape route before you start, keep a fast car outside, and bank the first four banks across stage V so the fifth is routine by the time you reach it.
steps: Locate a bank with an accessible vault.
Rob the vault and take the cash.
Escape the wanted level; repeat at five banks in total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armoured truck, take its cargo and get away. GTABase notes armoured trucks run set routes through the city: the rear doors are the weak point — heavy fire or explosives opens them — after which the cash is yours to grab before the response arrives. Escape cleanly to finish the trophy.
steps: Find an armoured truck on its route.
Force it to stop and blow the rear doors.
Take the cash and lose the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map of Leonida. Exploration registers as you enter each district, so the practical method is a full coastal-and-interior circuit in the cleanup stage, mopping up any fogged corners the story never took you to. PSNProfiles lists it among the non-hidden bronzes, so you can watch the map fill as you go.
steps: Finish the story to open the full map.
Drive or fly a circuit of every district.
Visit any remaining unexplored pockets until the map is complete.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation run by each gang in the game — variety is the requirement, not volume. PowerPyx's roadmap ties gang operations to their territories: rob one operation per gang, note which colours you have already hit, and move on. Expect resistance at every site; bring ammunition and an exit vehicle.
steps: Identify each gang's territory and one operation inside it.
Rob one operation per gang.
Escape after the final gang's operation is hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet-life trophy: buy or take a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and drink it looking at the view. GTABase's location index places the beach bars along the Ocean Beach strip; walk up to one in free roam, order, and let the animation finish — the trophy is in the pause, not the drink.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach in free roam.
Find a beachfront bar or cocktail spot.
Have the cocktail and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The classic exit: get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the showroom glass. Exophase's description is the whole recipe — no purchase required. Choose a showroom with a car facing the windows, get in, and accelerate straight through the pane.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom.
Get into one of the display cars.
Drive out through the front glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and complete the follow-through — play the bowling activity at that named alley rather than anywhere else. PSNProfiles lists it as a hidden bronze; find the alley on the map, start a game, and bowl your frames to the end.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Start a bowling game there.
Bowl through to the end of the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A deliberately cryptic hidden description pointing at the partner: PowerPyx reads these partner-feat bronzes as free-roam moments shared with your partner character. Keep your partner with you during stage V free roam and complete shared activities together; this one registers from a partner activity milestone, so the practical route is to do the partner feats as a set rather than hunting this one alone.
steps: Bring your partner along in free roam.
Complete activities and feats together.
Continue partner activities until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Another veiled hidden description, this one about choices: GTABase's mission coverage notes the story and strands present decision moments, and this trophy registers when a choice consequence plays out. Play naturally and commit to the choices the game offers rather than reloading them; it is listed as non-missable in this atlas because the game offers more choice points than the trophy needs.
steps: Take the decision points the story and strands offer.
Let the consequence of a choice play out.
Keep playing choices through stage V until it registers.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at failing once and succeeding on the retry: Exophase lists it among the hidden activity bronzes with no further public detail. The working method is repetition — activities, challenges and robberies all allow retries, so a failed attempt followed by a successful one in the same activity line is the natural trigger; it tends to arrive unplanned during stage V retries.
steps: Attempt an activity or challenge and let one run fail.
Retry the same activity immediately.
Complete it on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden oddity trophy — the description is a reaction, not an instruction, which in this series always marks a scripted strange encounter out in the world. PSNProfiles carries no public method beyond the description, so explore Leonida's remote corners in free roam, especially at night, and investigate any unusual encounter the game stages for you; witnessing it through to its end is the trigger.
steps: Explore remote areas of Leonida in free roam.
Investigate any strange encounter that triggers.
Stay and watch it play out to the end.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock pedestrians down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by swing that sends them sprawling like pins. PowerPyx's feat notes suggest a slow vehicle and a crowded pavement: ride or drive alongside a group, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect with a passer-by without stopping.
steps: Take a bike or open vehicle to a busy pavement.
Equip a melee weapon while riding.
Swing into a pedestrian as you pass, without stopping.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative quarter of a million dollars of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; GTABase's economy coverage treats laundering as the conversion step that makes robbery income clean. Feed every marked stack you earn through your contacts instead of spending around it, and the total accumulates across the whole playthrough.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Take them to your laundering contacts.
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops — any shops, any goods. Exophase's wording matches the official description: the counter is total spend, so vehicles, weapons, clothing and property dressing all count. It completes naturally if you kit yourself out during the story; if it lags, the cleanup stage is the time for a deliberate shopping round.
steps: Buy gear, vehicles and clothing as you play.
Keep spending through the story rather than hoarding cash.
Reach $100,000 total spent across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garages unlock for purchase as their districts open; PowerPyx's property notes make this an endgame purchase because the full set needs late-game money. Sweep the property listings after the story, buy each remaining garage, and the trophy lands with the final deed.
steps: Unlock property purchases through the story.
Buy each garage as it becomes available.
Purchase the last remaining garage property.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — the in-game vehicle registry. PSNProfiles lists the count at ten distinct vehicles: when you take a vehicle you intend to keep, register it in the app before moving on. Ten keepers accumulate quickly once garages enter the picture in stage VI.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register each vehicle you keep.
Reach 10 registered vehicles.
